description: Extract and reconcile decisions spread across six meeting transcripts (29 KB).

contract.objective: The notes directory in the task workspace contains six meeting transcripts. Each decision has an ID such as DEC-01. Write decisions.json as an object with a "decisions" array containing one entry per decision ID with "id", "summary" (one sentence), "owner" and "status" ("active", or "superseded" when a later decision replaced it). Ownership is specific to each decision ID: an active decision uses its latest assigned owner; a superseded decision retains the last owner it had before replacement. A replacement decision's new owner must not overwrite the owner of the superseded decision. Ignore discussion that only mentions an existing decision.
acceptance_criteria: Every decision ID in the notes appears exactly once
Statuses reflect replacements; owners follow the per-decision ownership policy, preserving a superseded decision's last owner before replacement
